cities.name: Reykjavík
cities.local_food_tip: Nordic soups, veggie stews, rye bread, potatoes, pastries and berry desserts — jednostavno, prirodno i jako ukusno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Sun Voyager sculpture & coastal walk. → 🏛️ Hallgrímskirkja (Exterior). → ☕ Cozy Nordic café.

Afternoon: 🎨 Harpa Concert Hall (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: Soups, rye bread, veggie dishes. → 🌿 Coastal pathways toward the harbor.

Sunset: 🌅 Perlan viewpoint (Exterior hill area).

Night: 🌃 Waterfront lights + dessert spots.

city_events.name: Reykjavík Arts Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Big cultural celebration with art and performances.
